description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceHandler component in an Android application, verifying its handling of device information, status, permissions, and health data.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for DeviceHandler, containing multiple test cases to check device handling functionalities.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Verifies that handleDeviceInfo returns a payload with expected device system details.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks the structure and validity of device status payload.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Validates device permissions payload and permission states.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests SMS capability logic when only send permission is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Tests SMS capability logic when only read permission is granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Tests behavior when no SMS permissions are granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Checks that SMS functionality is denied when SMS is disabled.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsMissingTelephonyAsDenied
methods.description: Ensures SMS capabilities are denied when telephony is unavailable.

methods.name: isSmsPromptable
methods.description: Determines whether the SMS permission prompt should be shown based on current permissions.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Asserts the structure and expected values for device health data.
